name: B10-0296/2025 (S&D) – Case of Ahmadreza Djalali in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Dr Ahmadreza Djalali in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is making a formal appeal to Iran and to European governments. It asks Iran to free Ahmadreza Jalali, a Swedish-Iranian professor held since 2016 and sentenced to death, and to stop all executions. It also asks the European Union to sanction officials responsible and to push harder for the release of detained European and dual citizens.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; this is an appeal, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Iran's government, detained European and dual citizens, and European Union officials.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to European Union bodies and to Iran's government; no action is guaranteed.
